title: Braided localization of degreewise clopen restriction with monoidal factorization
statement: Let j:Y→X be an open immersion and R a commutative ring sheaf on the small pro-etale site of X, with the coefficient universe fixed as in [def-pur-clopen-monoidal-normalization]. Give the actual degreewise restriction functor of [lem-pur-clopen-total-tensor-kflat-detection] any strong braided structure c. Suppose degreewise restriction preserves the independent-coefficient K-flat complexes of [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Then the specified exact derived restriction admits a strong braided structure d for the prescribed native derived monoidal structures, and the canonical factorization factors.hom is monoidal for c, d and the two fixed native lax braided localization functors. No summand or unit normalization is asserted here.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 0G7D, 06YU and 0FPT; the K-flat localization and normalized monoidal factorization steps of lem-pur-clopen-braided-model-normalization.

proof.text: Identify the independent-coefficient acyclic-tensor predicate with categorical K-flatness using kFlat_quotient_obj_iff and kFlat_iff_preserves_acyclic; the homotopy quotient detects acyclicity and symmetry supplies the other tensor order. Functorial flat resolutions give the K-flat left derivability structure.

Choose a cochain preimage of each derived object and resolve it by exists_isKFlatResolutionIndependentCoefficients. Localizing its quasi-isomorphism gives a K-flat model isomorphic to that object. The supplied hk sends these models to K-flat complexes in the target.

Use the fixed native lax braided localization functors, whose unit maps are invertible and whose tensorators are invertible on K-flat inputs. Apply normalizedBraidedLocalization to the given braided degreewise restriction, the specified exact derived restriction and factors. Retain its monoidal-factorization conclusion.

theorem clopen_braided_localization
    {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (j : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (R : Sheaf (topology X) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)})
    (c : (clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} j R).Braided)
    (hk : ∀ P : CochainComplex (clopenTensorModules.{t, u} R) ℤ,
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := topology X) (R := R) P →
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := topology Y)
        (R := (clopenTensorRings.{t, u} j).obj R)
        ((clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} j R).obj P)) :
    letI := c
    letI := RingedDerivedNative.laxBraided.{t + 1, t, u, max (u + 1) (t + 2)} (topology X) R
    letI := RingedDerivedNative.laxBraided.{t + 1, t, u, max (u + 1) (t + 2)}
      (topology Y) ((clopenTensorRings.{t, u} j).obj R)
    ∃ d : (derivedRestriction.{t, u} j R).Braided, letI := d
      NatTrans.IsMonoidal (factors.{t, u} j R).hom
